description: This file defines a React component for the event detail page in a Next.js application. It manages multiple tabs for event overview, ticket types, ticket generation, CSV import, check-in scanning, and reporting. It includes logic for fetching event data, handling download of ticket ZIP files, and rendering various UI components, including navigation and action buttons.

methods.name: downloadAll
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a ZIP file of all tickets for the event, saving it as a blob, or setting an error message if the download fails.
